defects.description: Distinct jobs scans all prior jobs for each id, exceeding the linear id-read budget.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { distinctJobs } from "./src/catalog.js"; let reads=0; const jobs=Array.from({length:1200}, (_,i)=>({get id(){reads++;return i;}})); distinctJobs(jobs); console.log(`id_reads=${reads}`);'

defects.why_missed: Small correctness-only batches do not measure resource usage.

defects.description: Label insertion retains every distinct key instead of enforcing the configured FIFO capacity.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { JobLabels } from "./src/catalog.js"; const labels=new JobLabels(32,id=>id); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++) labels.label(String(i)); console.log(`retained=${labels.size}`);'

defects.why_missed: Repeated hits on a few keys never exercise capacity replacement.
